Round 4: parentage from Pelletreau; in-law (no Bull Smith descent).

bio: Daughter of John Lyon Gardiner, 7th Lord of the Manor of Gardiner's Island; wife of David Thompson ([R4-S1]). She descends from the main Gardiner's Island line, not from Col. Abraham Gardiner and Mary Smith, so no Bull Smith descent is shown: an in-law. Her daughter Sarah G. Thompson married her cousin Col. David Lion Gardiner, Julia Tyler's brother ([R4-S1], [R4-S2]).
sources: [R4-S1] W. S. Pelletreau (ed.), Records of the Town of Smithtown (1898), Appendix (archive.org full text, scans recordsoftownofs00smitrich and recordstownsmit00pellgoog), App. pp. 469-470 (secondary) https://archive.org/details/recordsoftownofs00smitrich
[R4-S2] Curtiss C. Gardiner, Lion Gardiner and his Descendants (1890) (archive.org full text), p. 149 (secondary) https://archive.org/details/liongardinerhisd00gard
